conclusion: No blocker remains. Owner-only issue/revoke, server-derived worker identity, exact task/workspace/epoch/command/worker/expiry checks, replay after revoke, stale and cross-root zero-write behavior, one active grant per task/epoch, and persisted CommandReceiptV1 are enforced.
resolvedFindings: Removed the legacy MCP source-write bypass.
Stopped accepting client-asserted worker identity; MCP derives Pi only from an opaque lease and otherwise uses external_agent:mcp.
Bound grant validation inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE so rejected writes persist atomic not_started receipts.
Marked active grants from another runtime identity as stale on current-runtime read surfaces.
Required task workspace binding and rejected unknown worker types.
residualRisks: operation_log actor_type still records both Pi and external Agent as mcp; CommandReceiptV1 retains their exact actor identity.
Multi-item source receipts expose per-item revisions in data/readback rather than the top-level revision pair.
